about: What the test run cannot see for itself. scripts/plugins-python.mjs runs every official plugin and labels it from what happened; a plugin that runs without an error but cannot do its job here (it needs a program on the computer, a local server, …) is labelled by hand below, and these entries win over the run.

com.alsoknownasfoo.spinrender.note: It renders the board with a 3D renderer on the computer (OpenGL), which a browser tab does not have.

com.github.adamws.kicad-git.note: It runs the git program on the project folder. The web editor keeps history itself: Save version and Branches.

com.github.danielboston38.prefab-gate.note: It runs kicad-cli, a program of the desktop application.

com.github.kerstensrobin.kicad-breadboar.note: It runs kicad-cli, a program of the desktop application.

com.github.samuelcicuitstudio.traceforge.note: It starts a second program that talks to KiCad over a local network port; neither exists in a browser.

com.github.usetraces.traces.note: It needs the traces server running on the same computer.

com.infernoembedded.vulcans-trials.note: It runs a program that is bundled for the desktop.

com.github.z2labs.z2ems.note: Its windows open and the setup is saved. Simulating needs the Z2 EMS engine, a desktop program.

com.github.fablabkerala.gerber2png-plugi.note: It makes the Gerber archive and hands it over as a download. Passing it straight to the Gerber2Png page needs a local network port: open that page and load the archive there.

com.github.gauravmm.kleplacement.note: The plugin is broken as published: it imports itself under a folder name it is not installed as, on the desktop too.

com.github.BatNoize.Dial-Scale-FrontPane.note: It is a footprint wizard. The web editor has no footprint wizard dialog yet.

com.github.SK-Electronics-Consulting.kic.note: It is a footprint wizard. The web editor has no footprint wizard dialog yet.

com.github.yaqwsx.kikit.note: It is only a pointer to KiKit, a command line program that is installed separately on a computer.

com.github.f-blaze.velatrace.note: Its windows are written with Qt (PySide), which cannot run in a browser.

vn.thanhduongvs.component-position.note: Its windows are written with Qt (PySide), which cannot run in a browser.

vn.thanhduongvs.fanout-tool.note: Its windows are written with Qt (PySide), which cannot run in a browser.

com.github.Steffen-W.KiCad-Parasitics.note: It runs the ngspice circuit simulator as a separate program.

com.github.tobiglaser.KiPNG.note: It runs kicad-cli and the Cairo graphics library, programs of the desktop.

com.github.kicadlab.CopperFiller.note: It needs the shapely package, which is compiled code the test machine could not download. A server that can reach the Pyodide package CDN when it is built has it.
